resources.string: Close windows automatically when leaving the vehicle

WinClose — automatic window closing for MG4.

How it works:
• Monitors speed via the SAIC API
• When you exceed the speed threshold or drive longer than the arming duration, the system is armed
• Upon arrival, when you shift to P and operate the driver door:
→ after the closing delay, all 4 windows close automatically

Delay trigger mode:
• Door CLOSES (default): countdown starts when you close the door behind you after getting out
• Door OPENS: countdown starts as soon as the driver door opens
• Auto-cancel: any door movement during the delay cancels the close (e.g. you forgot something and come back)

Warning beep:
• A beep sounds at the start of the delay to warn you that windows are about to close
• Disabled by default — enable in settings
• Volume adjustable independently from the vehicle media volume

Advanced settings:
• Speed threshold: speed beyond which the car is considered to have been driven. Prevents triggering after startup without driving.
• Arming duration: minimum RUN duration before auto-arming (alternative to speed).
• Closing delay: time between door action and start of window closing.
• Per-window mode: AUTO / PULSE / OFF for each of the 4 windows.

Notes:
• 60 s cooldown between two closes
• Auto-rearm after each cycle
• Foreground service — restarts at boot
• Talks to CarVehicleSettingClient and CarStateClient from the SAIC launcher
